findings.opportunity: The per-projection overlay runs in the browser on every Semantic Browser interaction (focus, expanded, mode, view change re-apply it via DiagramUI.tsx). Inside nodes.map it scans the full element list twice per node (.find for declaration, .some for semantic children), and inside edges.map it re-filters the diff entries per edge and per relation triple via structuralEntries(source) plus .find. One projection apply is O(nodes x elements + edges x diffEntries) instead of O(nodes + elements + diffEntries).
findings.impact: For a model with hundreds of elements and a Change with many diff entries, every interaction drops from quadratic to linear scans, reducing per-interaction work and frame latency in the interactive Semantic Browser.
